# ArthaSetu India — Financial Intelligence Engine
> Authoritative, zero-error calculation models for Indian Income Tax, Loan Amortization, and GST.

## Canonical Data & Endpoints
- Website: https://arthasetu.in/
- License: Open Financial Intelligence

## Income Tax Slabs (New Tax Regime - Section 115BAC)
- Standard Deduction: ₹75,000 for salaried employees and pensioners.
- Slabs:
  - Up to ₹4,00,000: 0%
  - ₹4,00,001 – ₹8,00,000: 5%
  - ₹8,00,001 – ₹12,00,000: 10%
  - ₹12,00,001 – ₹16,00,000: 15%
  - ₹16,00,001 – ₹20,00,000: 20%
  - ₹20,00,001 – ₹24,00,000: 25%
  - Above ₹24,00,000: 30%
- Section 87A Rebate: 100% tax rebate up to ₹12,00,000 taxable income (Net Zero Tax on gross salary up to ₹12,75,000).
- Health & Education Cess: 4% on (Tax + Surcharge).

## Amortization Mathematical Model
- Loan EMI = [P * r * (1 + r)^n] / [(1 + r)^n - 1]
- Reducing Balance: Prepayments immediately reduce principal, bypassing future compound interest.
